CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_SuscriptorSalas_ObtenerDatosSuscriptor]
@Membresia_Id INT
AS
BEGIN


SELECT
	[Membresia].[Id],
	[Membresia].[ClaveMembresia],
	[Suscriptor].[Id] AS [suscriptor_Id],
	[Suscriptor].[Nombre] + ' ' + [Suscriptor].[ApellidoPaterno] + ' ' + [Suscriptor].[ApellidoMaterno] AS [nombreCompletoSuscriptor],
	[Suscriptor].[CorreoElectronico],
	[Suscriptor].[Telefono]
FROM [Membresia]
	JOIN [Suscripcion]
		ON [Membresia].[Id] = [Suscripcion].[Membresia_Id]
	JOIN [Suscriptor]
		ON [Suscripcion].[Suscriptor_Id] = [Suscriptor].[Id]
WHERE [Membresia].[Id] = @Membresia_Id
AND [Suscriptor].[Activo] = 1

END
Name: rpt_SuscriptorSalas_ObtenerDatosSuscriptor
